title: EvaluationClaw Task Agent Spec
description: Standard metadata.task_agent object for complex multi-turn, simulated, or agentic benchmark items.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this standardized task-agent JSON object.

agent_role.description: Role of the task-specific agent, such as dialogue_simulator, environment_controller, target_agent_executor, or judge.

system_prompt.description: Complete system prompt for the task-specific agent. It should state the evaluation being executed, the agent role, turn-by-turn behavior, constraints, and secrecy requirements.

initial_content.description: Initial scenario, state, persona, repository brief, visible files, or other setup needed to execute the item.

scenario.description: Natural-language description of the initial scenario or task context.

files.description: Initial visible files for repository/workspace/VM tasks. Keys are relative or guest paths; values are full file contents. VM tasks can materialize these into the guest before startup.

session.description: Optional GUI/browser/VM session state. session.asset_files or assets entries with path/content can be materialized into a VM guest.

asset_files.description: Inline files to create in the session or VM guest.

assets.description: Input files, URLs, documents, or inline asset objects. Inline file objects may contain path/content.

max_turns.description: Maximum number of helper-agent follow-up turns or simulated interaction steps.

initial_user_message.description: Optional first user message. If absent, BenchmarkItem.prompt is used.

user_turns.description: Optional deterministic follow-up user turns for multi-turn dialogue tasks.

followup_instruction.description: Instruction telling the helper agent how to choose the next user turn from the transcript.

stop_condition.description: When the task-specific agent should stop the interaction.

method.description: agent_judge/task_agent_judge uses the task agent as judge; runner_judge uses the normal judge with this guidance; deterministic uses environment scoring.

instructions.description: General scoring instructions for transcript or trace evaluation.

pass_fail.description: Pass/partial/fail standards for deterministic or simulated completion tasks.

environment_type.description: dialogue, workspace, code_sandbox, docker_workspace, or another runner-supported environment type.

agent_env.description: Optional built-in environment config. For current runner compatibility, also copy this object to metadata.agent_env. Docker workspace tasks may include image_build with enabled, base_image, apt/system packages, pip/python packages, npm/node packages, cran/r packages, bioconductor, julia, conda, cargo, go, gem, composer, apk/dnf/yum/pacman packages, install_steps, commands, dockerfile, context_files, tag, rebuild, or build_timeout. VM-backed tasks may include vm_materialization to tune guest_user, guest_root, enabled, include_task_manifest, include_evaluation_manifest, or overwrite_seed_iso, and vm_provisioning with enabled, apt/system, pip/python, snap, cran/r, bioconductor, julia, conda, cargo, go, gem, composer, apk/dnf/yum/pacman package fields, install_steps, commands, desktop_bridge_install_command, or desktop_bridge_start_command.

agent_task_package.description: Optional pointer or compact summary. The full ALE-style executable task package should be stored at metadata.agent_task_package and follow docs/agent-task-package-spec.schema.json.
